item.title: Toyota PH Tapped By Toyota Asia As Regional Hub For Technical Training
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines Corporation (TMP) strengthens its role in the regional automotive industry as it leads the first-ever technical training for Body, Paint, and Estimation (BPE) in the Philippines for instructors from Toyota Asia affiliates. Read More »

item.title: GAC Offering Free Wall Charger, 2 Years PMS With Aion UT, Aion V Until December 2026
item.description: Until December 31, 2026, customers who purchase and take delivery of a brand-new GAC Aion UT or GAC Aion V will receive a complimentary 7-kW Wall Charger alongside a Free Two-Year Preventive Maintenance Service (PMS) program. Read More »

item.title: iCAUR Philippines Signs First Batch Of Dealer Partners
item.description: iCaur Philippines has formally welcomed its first batch of dealer partners, strengthening the brand’s retail and aftersales network ahead of its formal launch later this year. Read More »

item.title: Omoda Jaecoo PH Signs 50th Dealership
item.description: Omoda and Jaecoo Motor Philippines Inc. marked a major milestone in its Philippine expansion with the signing of its 50th dealer partnership. The landmark number is attributed to MG Gateway South Corporation which was represented by its Vice-President, Martin Paulo Arancon during the formal signing.
